channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Wins this period include new outside-capital commitments: Hilton's $77M dual-brand San Juan hotel and plan to roughly double its Puerto Rico pipeline, Aman's Amantaru resort in Cabo Rojo within the $2B+ Esencia project, a $10M CVI.CHE 105 restaurant at Plaza Las Américas, and Aeroméxico's restored San Juan–Mexico City route starting June 2027. Treasury approved all 178 Puerto Rico Opportunity Zones 2.0 tracts, a notable investment-climate signal, though the map is about 80% smaller than the original. Risks center on energy and the fiscal picture: NFEnergía's gas interruption to San Juan units 5 and 6, LUMA spending about $1B below budget, a Fiscal Oversight Board order for a revised PREPA fiscal plan, and forecasters expecting stagnation in 2027. Encanto Restaurants' Chapter 11 filing, with about 2,600 jobs lost after Yum! Brands ended the franchise, is the main local employment shock.
